title: NITI Aayog Launches Report on “Reimagining Care: Strategies for Empowering Caregivers in Viksit Bharat@2047”
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

NITI Aayog

NITI Aayog Launches Report on “Reimagining Care: Strategies for Empowering Caregivers in Viksit Bharat@2047”

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
05 AUG 2026 9:43PM by PIB Delhi

NITI Aayog today released the report titled “
Reimagining Care: Strategies for Empowering Caregivers in Viksit Bharat@2047”
 at NITI Aayog.

The report presents India’s caregiving ecosystem and outlines a comprehensive roadmap for building an organised, professional, accessible and future-ready system of care. It positions caregivers at the centre of the care ecosystem, recognising caregiving as a skilled, dignified and valued profession, while emphasising quality of care, professional recognition, workforce welfare, institutional support, and enabling families and communities to access reliable and affordable care. The report also underlines the growing need to develop a cadre of trained caregivers to address the current and future demand of care services in the country and also the potential opportunities for Indian caregiver professionals at the global platform.

The report was released by
Shri Ashok Kumar Lahiri, Vice Chairperson, NITI Aayog, in the presence of Dr. R. Balasubramaniam, Member, NITI Aayog and Ms. Nidhi Chhibber, CEO, NITI Aayog, and senior
 officials from NITI Aayog.
The launch was attended by the representatives of Central Ministries, viz., Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Ministry of External Affairs, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, National Institutes, UN agencies such as UNFPA, WHO, UNRC, World Bank, Asian Development Bank, ILO, etc., and other stakeholders providing caregiver training courses/ programs.

Speaking on the occasion,
Shri Ashok Kumar Lahiri, Vice Chairperson, NITI Aayog
, stated that the global demand for caregivers presents a unique opportunity to establish India as a global leader in traditional caregiving, unlock substantial economic value, create employment, strengthen recognition and social security for caregivers, as well as reinforce India's cultural and knowledge-based soft power. He emphasised that the report provides a comprehensive roadmap to strengthen institutional convergence, empower family and professional caregivers, and position India as a global hub for skilled caregiving services.

Dr R. Balasubramaniam, Member, NITI Aayog,
emphasised that Seva and Samvedana have always been at the heart of India's civilisational ethos, and caregiving reflects these timeless values. He highlighted that a robust caregiving ecosystem would strengthen social inclusion, develop a caring society, empower communities, create quality livelihoods and contribute significantly to the vision of
Viksit Bharat@2047
.

The report prepared Social Justice and Empowerment Division of NITI Aayog draws upon extensive stakeholder consultations, international benchmarking, surveys, and field visits and identifies opportunities to position India as a global leader in caregiving services.

The report envisions caregiving as a critical pillar of India's social and economic transformation and positions it as an essential enabler of inclusive and sustainable development in the journey towards
Viksit Bharat@2047
. With the country’s strong belief in traditional compassionate caregiving and the global demand for caregivers, India is at a unique position to capitalize demographic dividend and to explore global opportunities for expanding its care network and skilled workforce.

The report organises its recommendations across several strategic pillars, including policy, professional recognition of caregivers, workforce development, global cooperation, social security, family and community-based care, etc.

The Report also presents a roadmap for an organised, professional caregiving ecosystem through a National Policy on Caregiving, and a  National Caregiver Council.

Access the full report here:
https://www.niti.gov.in/sites/default/files/2026-08/Reimagining-Care-Strategies-for-Empowering-Caregivers-in-Viksit-Bharat-2047.pdf
